material: Restored first-version faceted shading; runtime shared shader remaps source luminance to element main colour, shadow and light highlight.
preview_method: CPU evaluation of the shared shader luminance formula in the project's current Gamma colour space; not a Unity capture or visual acceptance.
initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent PNG card-bottom status icon for a Genshin-inspired card battle, the shared Hypostasis elemental SHELL. Input image 1 (HypostasisShell white glyph) is a SHAPE reference only: a compact cluster of chunky cubic armor blocks forming a 2-by-2-by-2 shell with visible small gaps, seen in isometric view. Keep that immediately recognizable cube-shell silhouette, simplify tiny carved motifs into a few broad angular grooves. Input image 2 (StoneStele) is a painted UI icon STYLE reference only: clean thick contours, faceted solid volume, simplified shading, readable at 32-64 pixels. Do NOT copy its pillar, diamond decoration, or saturated golden color. Color palette: the dominant flat midtone of all cube armor is the project's LIGHT BROWN #998F81, with project dark brown #716758 for shaded faces, deeper brown #4D463C for a restrained silhouette outline, and sparse pale warm-beige edge highlights. Overall muted light taupe-brown, no saturated yellow/orange/gold, no green, purple, blue, elemental glow, or element-specific color. The icon is neutral and shared by Anemo, Electro and Geo Hypostasis. Composition: centered on a square canvas, total solid silhouette about 68-72% of canvas width and height, all corners within a circular-safe centered footprint and generous transparent padding, readable solid cube faces with clean simple planes, small transparent gaps between blocks, no visible central crystal and no added elemental symbol. Stylized hand-painted game item/status icon, crisp anti-aliased edges, 2-3 clear value planes per cube, no photorealistic noise, no blurry aura, no sparkles. Background must be genuinely transparent, including all outside space. Do not draw a background disc, frame, badge, text, numbers, scenery, character, ground shadow or checkerboard pattern. Deliver only the single light-brown cube-shell status icon.
matte_trial_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the supplied transparent Hypostasis cube-shell status icon. Preserve exactly the same group of cube blocks, their isometric arrangement, silhouette, relative sizes, broad carved angular motifs, centered square composition and generous transparent padding. Change the MATERIAL from shiny beveled bronze/metal to MATTE LIGHT-BROWN STONE. Dominant project light taupe-brown remains #998F81, soft shadow color near #716758. Remove ALL bright cream/white bevel edge strips and ALL sharp diagonal reflective highlight bands across faces. Replace those glossy contrasts with broad, quiet, softly blended diffuse light and shadow: front faces light taupe, top faces only slightly lighter, side faces moderately darker, all rough/matte stone with absolutely no specular shine. Keep the geometric cube edges defined by silhouettes and restrained dark-brown separating lines, not luminous rims. Reduce the carved grooves' depth and contrast so they read as shallow simple stone incisions rather than deep metallic channels; keep enough clarity for a 32-64 px UI icon. Smooth unpolished stone surfaces, not noisy grain, not concrete pores, no cracks, chips, added distress, ornaments, new objects or glow. Make any small gaps between blocks truly transparent rather than filled by white patches. Keep substantial opaque stone faces and true alpha transparency everywhere outside the blocks. No background, frame, badge, text, numbers, ground shadow or checkerboard. The final result must immediately read as muted matte carved stone, not gold, bronze, polished ceramic or metal.

display_note: 公共非Count外壳按真实有效实例显示，不显示数字并置顶。无相之风/雷/岩共用一图，MainColor=IntrinsicElement按实际宿主固有元素取项目色表；七元素或#RRGGBB也可显式指定，未填主色保留原图。不调用业务ScriptHook、不改变减伤或核心显露规则。保留原始状态图标；哑光试稿未采用，已恢复第一版光影。
